purpose: R2-E2 session-independent 60-epoch confirmation. All operating points are selected only from sessions belonging to the outer-training partition.
outer_units: 86 acquisition sessions whose original split is train or test
inner_selection: deterministic session split within each outer-training partition
selection_rule: For each residual candidate, maximize validation material balanced accuracy + 0.25 x validation pair resolution; ties favor higher validation cosine, then lower injection scale, lower rank, and lower fine-loss weight. The direct replacement applies the same score only among candidates with validation cosine >= 0.94; if none exists, it uses maximum cosine, then score.
refit_rule: After representation and readout regularization are selected on inner-train/inner-validation only, refit the selected adapter for exactly 60 epochs on the complete outer-training sessions. The held-out outer session is evaluated once and never enters normalization, spectral basis estimation, threshold selection, model selection, or readout selection.
